summary: The fact layer behind this brief was generated at 2026-11-12T20:42:41Z, which is 15:42 ET and 18 minutes before the US close, so every US and theme figure here is a late-session snapshot, not a settlement. The session's defining event is idiosyncratic: Nvidia's board moved on Jensen Huang after an affair investigation, the chief executive resigned, CFO Colette Kress was named interim, and Wachtell, Lipton was retained. NVDA printed 164.045, down 5.5747 percent on the day. What did not happen is a sector de-rating: the semis row is up 0.5807 percent because AVGO added 4.8751 percent and AMD added 5.0335 percent, so the tape repriced one name and redistributed its share. The risk score nevertheless rose 4.90 to 67.12, and the entire increase is cross-asset confirmation moving from 37.50 to 75.00, a contribution of 5.625, with 6 of the 8 production signals now firing. Only 2 of the 22 sector and theme rows are up, and the mean is -1.3654 percent. Volatility subtracted 1.1955 from the score instead, because VIX changed vintage from 19.46 to 17.49, which is not a market move. The regime label reads risk_on, but only by fallthrough: breadth at 0.3548 sits 0.48 percentage points above the 0.35 risk_off trigger.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the market treats it as a single-company governance event
points: The board completes a CEO search, the investigation does not widen into the supply chain, and the AI complex reprices one name only, extending the 0.5807 percent gain in semis.

Of the 4.90 rise, 5.625 comes from the cross-asset rule block, where the -6.2163 small-cap gap is a 63 trading session measure and the crypto and copper legs are single-day prints, all of which can mean-revert.
VIX at 17.49 is still far from the stress zone, and if breadth stabilises above 0.35 the score can settle back near 62.

base_case.title: Base case: churning at a high level with the label stuck on a threshold
points: The score churns between 65 and 70, extending the 10th consecutive high_risk session.
NVDA stays under pressure into the 2026-11-17 earnings while rotation inside semis keeps the index flat and breadth grinding lower.
There is no new rates or credit data, so the macro dimension at 74.58 and liquidity and credit at 72.01 barely move.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the investigation widens into a hot inflation print
points: If the investigation reaches into supply chain relationships or the CEO search drags, the AI financing chain is repriced and NVDA's counterparty web turns from an equity question into a credit question.
Breadth breaking 0.35 flips the regime back to risk_off, and a hot 2026-11-13 inflation print would press from the real rate at 2.66 and the dollar at 121.8803 at the same time.
The score would then retest the 71.40 high of 2026-11-05, which is only 4.28 above the current 67.12.
